carousels.caption: When should you actually kill an ad? Most owners either pull the plug after one bad day or let a dead ad bleed money for weeks because nobody set a number up front. Here's the exact ratio that tells you when it's over, and when it just needs a couple more days.
carousels.cta: Comment MATH and I'll send you the blank sheet so you can set your own target CPA and run the math.
carousels.pinnedComment: If your cost per lead is running 3x your target after you've spent 2-3x that target chasing it, and the ad is past day 7 and $100, kill it. If it's 1.5-3x, give it a few more days before you touch anything.
